attrs.statedReason: Cross-platform boundary for the persistent PTY backend, including ConPTY on Windows. Pulled in by @earendil-works/pi-ai (optional LLM API backend). pnpm lists them only because they ship lifecycle scripts, but those are no-ops we don't need, so we deny them — install still succeeds. JSONL durability calls MoveFileExW with write-through publication on Windows. Consumers pin 3.1.1: Koffi 3.3.2's source build fails under GCC 13 when optional prebuilts are omitted. Upgrade all consumers together after the replacement passes that build and the release packed-install check. The Python runtime deploy includes the reviewed workspace postinstall that restores the executable bit on node-pty's macOS spawn helper. electron-builder pulls in the optional Squirrel.Windows helper, whose install script only selects its bundled 7-Zip executable. Desktop ships Windows through NSIS, so that mutation is not part of our build.

Native Codex and Claude tests qualify this exact release with its local patches. Office engines and their API are qualified and released together by the kit repository. Fresh pi-ai releases carry the model catalog updates that are the whole point of bumping it; waiting out the release age would defeat that. This addon release recognizes the Electron 44.7.0 Node/V8 fingerprint used by Desktop. The active pnpm supply-chain policy blocks this reviewed runtime closure until its release-age window expires unless every exact package is exempt. All platform aliases resolve to the @openai/codex package name, so their reviewed exact versions must share one version-union policy entry. The native computer-use provider pins this reviewed upstream runtime closure. The package manager is a workspace devDependency, so its own exact pin must be exempt from the release-age window that guards other packages. Desktop packaging requires this Electron fingerprint with node-addon-require-builtin 0.1.9.
